purpose: Keep every buyer, supplier, and founder action proof-led before it enters production records.
rule: Every next action shows one proof score, one readiness state, one money rule, and one calm next move.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, or booking commission is handled by Heavyster in phase one.

role_gates.safe_action: Send a direct enquiry only when proof, availability, supplier route, and direct payment rule are visible.
role_gates.proof_signal: Cat 320 Excavator has visible proof, availability, supplier route, and direct payment rule.

role_gates.safe_action: Publish a paid listing only when machine proof, availability freshness, and lead route are clean.
role_gates.proof_signal: Gulf Lift Services can publish one machine with clean documents and visible SaaS pricing.

role_gates.safe_action: Scale a market only when demand, supply gap, proof score, and listing ARR are visible.
role_gates.proof_signal: UAE Lifting has demand, supply gap, proof, and ARR signal before opening market command.

acceptance: Marketplace shows the Serene Proof Gate before the hero.
